motivation: The existing composition-label holdout reuses some archive units. US and India archive strata are disjoint and permit a stricter calibration-transfer check without changing physical plans.
excluded_from_training_and_testing: multinational_source_balanced, because it overlaps both country strata
same_other_contracts: Same original 7 spreads, 4 budgets, 3 seeds, 4 contexts, candidate scores, action library, eligibility tolerance and selection rule
independence: No release_unit_id used by the held-out stratum occurs in margin calibration. No source building is shared across these country strata. This does not establish independent real-building validation. The candidate library remains the original common finite library.
stop_rule: Execute both directions for all three existing rules. Preserve errors and gaps. Do not refit the margin quantile to this test.
